name: comnview
description: Review websites, screens and PDFs with your clients in Comnview: read and answer the comments they pin, run design audits that pin each issue where it is, capture web pages and send them for review.

interface.longDescription:
Comnview is where clients review websites, screens and PDFs by pinning comments right where they mean them. Connect your Comnview account, and ChatGPT can work through that feedback with you.

Ask "What did the client say on the brochure?" and ChatGPT finds the project, lists the open comments in pin order, and opens any of them with what the pin points at: the text under it on a PDF page, a crop of the picture, or the element on the web page. It drafts replies, posts them once you agree, and resolves the threads you have dealt with.

It can also review on its own. Ask for a design audit of a web page, a set of screens or a PDF: ChatGPT captures the page or opens the project, looks at all of it, and pins each issue where it is, with why it matters and a concrete fix. When you say so, it emails the project to up to five people for review. It can also take a full-page screenshot of a public web page, and keep your Dashboard tidy: rename projects, file them in folders, reorder pages and set a link password.

In Codex, it can also download the file and upload the corrected one as a new version, so the whole loop runs in one place: read the feedback, fix the source, upload version 2, reply and resolve.

Good to know:
- Comments and replies are posted as you, and your clients get the usual email. ChatGPT asks before it posts, resolves, uploads, deletes or sends anything.
- Deleting a page, a project or your own comment moves it to Trash for 30 days, where it can be restored.
- When you connect, you sign in on comnview.com and choose what ChatGPT may do: read only, read and reply, or full access. Disconnect any time in Profile > Agents on comnview.com.
- Comment texts come from your reviewers and are treated as feedback, never as instructions.
- Requires a Comnview account with AI agent access.
- ChatGPT can't download or upload files; use Codex for new versions.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the open client feedback on my latest project
Draft replies to the comments still waiting for me
Do a design audit of my homepage and pin the issues

positive.description: Summarize the open feedback on a project without changing anything.
positive.prompt: Summarize the open feedback on the Fernhouse brochure.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open comment threads on the Fernhouse brochure grouped by page, in pin order, each with its author (Jana (client)) and the request in one line, and says which threads still wait for a reply. With the sample data: the headline on page 1 (already answered), the delivery time on page 2 and the phone number on page 3. Posts, resolves and uploads nothing.

positive.description: Open one comment with what its pin points at.
positive.prompt: Open the comment about the phone number on the Fernhouse brochure and show me what it points at.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that thread (page 3, from Jana (client)) with the text under the pin on that PDF page, so the reviewer can see which line the client means. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Reply to a client comment as the account owner, after confirmation.
positive.prompt: Reply to the comment about the delivery time on the Fernhouse brochure: We'll change it to 2 days in the next version.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the reply for confirmation (reply is marked as a write), then posts it under the account's name on the page 2 thread and confirms it was posted. The thread stays open, because the prompt did not ask to resolve it.

positive.description: Design audit of a public web page: capture it and pin the issues where they are.
positive.prompt: Do a design audit of https://comnview.com/agents and pin the issues.
positive.expected_behavior: Captures the page into a new project in the account, looks at the whole page, and pins 5 to 12 comments, each on the element it concerns, with a short title, why it matters and a concrete fix. Ends with the project link and the three issues to fix first. Sends nothing to anyone. Capturing takes up to about a minute.

positive.description: Full-page screenshot of a public web page.
positive.prompt: Take a full-page screenshot of https://comnview.com/agents.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a download link to one PNG of the whole page, top to bottom, and says it is also kept as a project in the account.

negative.description: Billing is out of scope. No tool changes plans or takes payments, so ChatGPT should say it can't change the plan or pay, and that plans are managed on comnview.com. It must not open or link a checkout.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Comnview account to the Business plan and pay with my saved card.

negative.description: Other people's comments can't be deleted. delete_my_comment removes only the account's own comments, so ChatGPT should explain that it can't delete the client's comments and may offer to resolve the threads instead, only after the user agrees. Nothing is deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete all the comments my client left on the Fernhouse brochure.

negative.description: Account and team administration is out of scope. No tool invites people to a team or changes roles, so ChatGPT should say it can't do that and that team members are managed on comnview.com. It must not email the person a project with share_for_review as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Add anna@example.com to my Comnview team as an admin.

review.commerce_description: Comnview sells nothing inside ChatGPT or Codex. It works with an existing Comnview account; plans are managed on comnview.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and answer the comments clients pin on websites, pictures and PDFs; design audits that pin each issue where it is; website capture and full-page screenshots; sending a project for review; Dashboard organisation and Trash. Skills: Get started, Client feedback, Design audit.
